rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an event happening or taking place.

example.english: These accidents occur all the time.
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 ji3 ngoi6 seng4 jat6 faat3 sang1

rows.note: Use this when an opportunity, possibility, or other option presents itself.

example.english: This opportunity does occur at last.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gei1 wui6 zung1 jyu1 ceot1 jin6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when a person, event, or thought comes to someone’s mind, especially as a recollection.

example.english: Whenever memories of that trip occur to me, I can't help laughing.
example.traditional: 我一諗起嗰次旅行就忍唔住笑。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 nam2 hei2 go2 ci3 leoi5 hang4 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3
